body: This enduro tour is your ticket to the heart of the "Vietnamese Alps," where you'll find cool coniferous forests and misty highlands in Dalat instead of the scorching beach heat. You'll ride along red dirt trails at the foot of Mount Langbiang, tackle steep climbs through pine forests, and explore hidden coffee plantations accessible only through wild off-road paths. The panoramic views are cinematic, from the mirror-like Lake Tuyen Lam to the endless ranges of the "Cloud Mountains."

The route takes you through authentic ethnic minority villages and steep forest clearings. Experienced instructors will guide you through the tricky terrain, helping you navigate slippery surfaces and confidently tackle the mountain passes, providing you with a thrilling and controlled riding experience. This is a concentrated blend of mountain freshness, technical riding, and the rugged beauty of the central highlands. It's an enduro challenge that will change the way you perceive Vietnam!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THE PACKAGE
High-quality Honda XR150L/Honda XR230L/Yamaha WR 155 motorcycle or other motorcycle with a full fuel kit.
The tour price includes meals (1 lunch with local Vietnamese cuisine).
Bike damage (In case of damage caused by the driver, the renter is responsible for repairs and restoration)

body: Этот эндуро-тур — ваш билет в сердце «Вьетнамских Альп», где вместо изнуряющей пляжной жары вас ждут прохладные хвойные леса и туманное высокогорье Далата. Вы прокатитесь по тропам из красной глины у подножия горы Лангбианг, преодолеете крутые подъемы через сосновые боры и исследуете скрытые кофейные плантации, доступные только по дикому бездорожью. Панорамные виды здесь кинематографичны: от зеркальной глади озера Туен Лам до бесконечных хребтов «Облачных гор». Маршрут проходит через аутентичные деревни этнических меньшинств и крутые лесные просеки. Опытные инструкторы помогут вам освоить сложный рельеф, научат уверенно проходить скользкие участки и горные перевалы, обеспечивая драйв под полным контролем. Это концентрированный коктейль из горной свежести, техничной езды и суровой красоты Центрального нагорья. Эндуро-вызов, который полностью изменит ваше представление о Вьетнаме!

Встреча и подбор снаряжения. Мы собираемся в кафе, знакомимся и подготавливаем экипировку. Пока вы примеряете защиту, мы выясняем ваш уровень подготовки. Для начинающих подбираем легкий обучающий ритм, а уверенным райдерам сразу предлагаем техничные маршруты средней сложности.
2. Инструктаж: Техника и правила дорожного движения

Подробный инструктаж и пробный заезд. На городской площадке вы освоите управление байком под контролем гидов и совершите первый выезд перед стартом основного маршрута. До точки начала тура участники добираются сами.

Мы определяем тайминг и выезжаем на трек. Гид постоянно контролирует группу, не уезжая вперед более чем на 150 метров, и собирает всех в тени или на удобных площадках. Мы подсказываем, как проходить сложные участки, и снимаем качественный контент на каждой видовой точке.
Питание на треке и завершение поездки. Финальный этап, где мы отдыхаем, обсуждаем маршрут за перекусом и спокойно возвращаемся к месту встречи.

body: The surroundings of Da Lat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to see everything. No matter which direction you go, you'll find panoramic hard tracks, cliffs, and mirror-like lakes. We've combined the best locations into a two-day itinerary, starting with the famous Suoi Vang Lake and ending with the remote Tam Tam Waterfall, hidden deep within the pine forests.

You'll navigate through coffee and strawberry plantations, tackling steep inclines and challenging terrains that are physically impossible to cover in a single day. This is a full immersion in the wild nature of the highlands: a rush, absolute freedom, and honest extreme. This adventure happens once in a lifetime — book your spot and get the most out of your time in Vietnam!

No matter which direction you go, you'll find panoramic hard tracks, cliffs, and mirror-like lakes. We've combined the best locations into a two-day itinerary, starting with the famous Suoi Vang Lake and ending with the remote Tam Tam Waterfall, hidden deep within the pine forests.

You'll navigate through coffee and strawberry plantations, tackling steep inclines and challenging terrains that are physically impossible to cover in a single day. This is a full immersion in the wild nature of the highlands: a rush, absolute freedom, and honest extreme. This adventure happens once in a lifetime — book your spot and get the most out of your time in Vietnam!

body: The surroundings of Dalat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to master the art of off-road riding. We’ve designed a two-day Easy Rider course that combines intensive training with a breathtaking journey. From the mirror-like Suoi Vang Lake to the hidden Tyam Tyam Waterfall, you will learn to ride where others wouldn't dare to walk.

Forget the stress of city traffic. You’ll practice gear shifting and clutch control while navigating through picturesque coffee plantations and pine forest trails. This itinerary is built to gradually increase in complexity, allowing you to tackle your first steep inclines and rocky paths with confidence. It’s not just a lesson; it’s a full immersion into the wild highlands. Gain real skills, feel absolute freedom, and discover a Vietnam you won't find in any guidebook. Your journey into the world of Enduro starts here!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.

body: This enduro tour is a unique chance to see the surroundings of Nha Trang from a height that is not accessible to ordinary tourists! You will race along the serpentine roads of Khanh Le Pass, the rocky paths of the jungle, and see the wild waterfalls that are hidden from view. The panoramic views are breathtaking, from the emerald jungle to the vast South China Sea.

The medium-difficulty route is the perfect balance of excitement and safety. Experienced instructors will guide you through the forested areas and mountain climbs, ensuring a thrilling experience without unnecessary risks. This is a powerful mix of extreme sports, Vietnam's wild nature, and absolute freedom. The buzz is guaranteed - this day will be the highlight of your vacation!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.

program.en:
Day 1. Saigon - Nam Cat Tien National Park (180km)
Start this amazing 4 day motorbike tour south Vietnam with the ride off the beaten track to Cat Tien National park!Pick you up at the hotel at around 8:30 am, take you to our starting point and start the ride at around 9 am after rush hour. Just a short ride we will be on the bank of Dong Nai river where we take a ferry to the other side where our ride is more interesting to Tri An lake. This lake is one of the largest lakes in Vietnam and built for producing hydropower.After lunch, the ride will be more enjoyable, We will take the back roads through the jungle of Ma Da. Here we have an opportunity to explore the tunnels of Duong Minh Chau base of the Viet Cong in the 60s. Next, you continue your tour on smaller roads through the fertile natural reserve before you get on another ferry taking us to nearby Nam Cat Tien National Park. This park is a biodiversity park hosting many rare mammals, birds, reptiles, and flora. Overnight in a lodge next to the park.

Day 2. Nam Cat Tien - Ta Dung Lake (160km)
Today is even greater with some fun offroad motorbike ride in central highlands and the view is more beautiful. After breakfast, get on the bike and hit the road to Da Teh, an isolated town surrounded by tea and coffee plantations, and continue over mountains passes. Let yourself get swallowed up in the picturesque scenic highland, a sea of green color everywhere you look to the endless horizon.We will arrive the lake in the early afternoon, check in the room and have time to relax to walk for some lake view or we can motorbike more around to discover some villages surroundings

Day 3. Ta Dung Lake - Mui Ne (190km)
After breakfast, we take a stunning winding motorbike ride down to the coast to the oceanfront town of Mui Ne. The trip certainly can stop at vegetable and flower farms, coffee plantations to get a look at the changes in land use as we emerge from the lower central highlands. We can do some fun offorad motorbike ride in the morning. The road hits 1000 meters as we first ascend before traversing the pass for the descent. This south Vietnam motorbike tour also includes some spectacular views along the way down to the coast.We will stop in Mui Ne for a relaxing afternoon on the beach and taking in some of the nightlife of busy Mui Ne.

Day 4. Mui Ne - Saigon (250km)
Today is a big and great day with a lot of things to do and see. It’s a pity if you miss the chances to explore the simple life of locals with their fishing net, small wooden boats in the early morning. It is usually to see the one-man traditional fishing vessel, the coracle.We will start the tour back to Saigon with amazing ride on the breath-taking coastal roads crossing some salt farms and many dragon fruit plantations. This motorcycle ride will get closer to the sea in Ho Tram and Ba Ria then the last part is the slowly ride on the busy road to the city of Saigon. If you can’t enjoy the ride with the local traffic, we can drop the bikes out of the city, saying good bye to the guide team ofVietnam Motorbike Tour Expertand we will take the taxi back to your hotel in city center of Saigon.

program.en:
Day 1. Saigon - Cu Chi tunnels - Dong Xoai (150km)
Start this great motorbike tour from Saigon at 9 AM from your hotel in Ho Chi Minh city. We will be at Cu Chi tunnel after around 2 hour motorbike ride through some villages in the countryside to the North of Saigon, spend around 2 hours to discover the tunnel and learn more about the history of Vietnam War. After lunch, we keep riding through some large rubber tree garden to Dong Xoai town where the Ho Chi Minh trail end in the south of Vietnam. It could be a fun offroad motorbike tour crossing some rubber tree forest before arriving in a little quiet town of Dong XoaiDinner and overnight in Hotel in Dong Xoai.

Day 2. Dong Xoai - Dak Mil (195km)
After breakfast, we continue the Vietnam motorbike tour on the Ho Chi Minh trail and do take some visits of beautiful villages, War monument and cashew nut factory especially the trail takes us along the Cambodia border. Today is long ride and it must be the best of this South Vietnam motorbike tour from Saigon because it offers nice view of mountains in the highlands beside plenty of visits to the historical sites and ethnic people that make you understand better about the Vietnamese history and culture.Overnight in Dak Mil

Day 3. Dak Mil - Lak Lake (110km)
Keep motorcycle touring on Ho Chi Minh trail and stop more at the villages of hill tribe (M’nong, Ba Na people). We will pass some beautiful waterfall with a green water pool where we can have great swim. After picnic lunch at one of the waterfall, we motorcycle to the Lak lake – the second largest lake in Vietnam and spend the rest of the day at the lake (swimming or hunting the pictures of sunset).Overnight in a guesthouse nearby the lake – Home stay.

Day 4. Lak Lake - Da lat (180km)
This motorbike tour to Da Lat must be another highlight of this 5 day motorbike touring from Saigon. It’s quite a long ride on and offroad but we will have a lot of chances to visit mushroom farm or flower garden, waterfall… short trek up hills or villages of the hill tribes. When we get close to Da Lat, we can have an enjoyable offroad motorcycle tour through the pine tree hills to Da Lat.Overnight in a hotel in Da Lat.

Day 5. Da Lat - Nha Trang (150km)
This is a easy motorbike tour to Nha Trang, most of the ride is on big and smooth road except the small “monkey bridge” just after Da Lat town. We will do some stops to visit King Bao Dai’s palace or peaceful villages of the hill tribe along the way.The 5 Day South Vietnam motorbike tour from Saigon to Nha Trang will finish at around 4.30 PM in Nha Trang city after saying good bye to the staff ofVietnam Motorbike Tour Expertyou can enjoy your free relaxing time at one of the most beautiful beach in the world before flying back home or back to Ho Chi Minh city.

program.en:
Day 1. Ho Chi Minh City - Chau Doc (220km)
At 8:00 am, we start the motorbike tour from Saigon to Chau Doc – a busy town in western side of the Mekong river delta. Today’s ride is a great experience the funny and busy traffic in Vietnam, besides, some parts of the ride offers a great view of the large rice fields. It’s big day but must be a memorable day of motorbike tour in southern Vietnam. Arrive Chau Doc at around 5:00 pm.Overnight in a hotel

Day 2. Chau Doc - Can Tho (150km)
It’s a great day tour in Mekong delta. Before a enjoyable motorbike tour in Mekong delta we’ll have an hour motorboat trip to a floating village and have visit to Cham village, mosque and sarong workshop and then cross lower river to Chau Giang Dist. Ride on dirt track to Cho Moi, past Hoa Hao Buddhist Holly pagoda. After lunch in Cho Moi, we take a little ferry to the Island to get to the Monastery, which was built 120 years ago by the French. This is the first Monastery building site in Indochina, established in 1874.Then heading the southeast to Can Tho. Arrival Can Tho in the late afternoon. Check in the room in hotel

Day 3. Can Tho - Ben Tre (120km)
Getting up early to take a boat trip to Cai Rang floating market – one of the most famous and busiest fruit market in South Vietnam because the market opens very early and then get back to hotel for checking out and have breakfast before motorcycle to Can Tho city for a short visit at Can Tho central market and Binh Thuy ancient house whose design is a combination of Vietnam and France with interesting involved stories but also a garden with various flowers and fruits, including a wide range of orchids and a record cactus.After that it’s a beautiful motorbike tour through the Mekong delta to Ben Tre. Finish the day at 4:30 pm in a peaceful village in Ban Tre. Home stay.

Day 4. Ben Tre - Vung Tau (170km)
Enjoy simple breakfast with friendly family. After saying good bye to them, we will take a rowing boat trip on small waterways. Experience the true life of the delta region as you visit its fruit orchards, coconut groves, Bee farm and enjoy honey tea, seasonal fruit, fresh coconut candy and southern Vietnamese folk music.Disembark habour, then keep motorcycle touring to Vung Tau. Arrival Vung Tau in the late afternoon.Check in hotel and overnight in Vung Tau

Day 5. Vung Tau - Mui Ne (180km)
After breakfast, pay a visit to Dam historical mountain and Long Phuoc Tunnels.Then motorcycle to Phuoc Hai hamlet, this is one of the most beautiful coastal road motorcycle tour in Vietnam, the road is between mountains and beaches. After lunch in Phuoc Hai, keep motorbike touring on coastlines passing quiet pine forest of Loc An and we arrive Binh Chau hot spring, take a mud bath and relax on Hot Spring Lake .Afternoon, enjoy a great motorcycle ride to beautiful beach Mui Ne. Finish the beautiful motorbike tour on coastal roads in south Vietnam with having a swim at Mui Ne beach.Check in the room in small hotel close to the beach.

Day 6. Mui Ne - Sai Gon (220km)
After breakfast, Back on our motorbike and ride forwards to famous Mui Ne Cape. On the way, pay a visit at the Fairy stream, then pause to discover the fishing village of Mui Ne and further on is the enormous red sand dunes. Continue your motorbike tour to Ho Chi Minh city and do some stop at fishing villages to discover how fishermen doing the daily work: net fishing, selling fish, mending fishing net.We will be back to Saigon and finish great motorbike tour Mekong delta and coastlines at about 5:00 pm.

Подбор экипировки и знакомство. Встречаемся, общаемся и примеряем защиту. В зависимости от вашего стажа мы скорректируем программу: для новичков — вводный курс и легкий темп, для профи — незамедлительный выход на трассы среднего уровня.

Инструктаж по технике и тренировка. Мы встретимся на площадке в городе для обучения и тестового заезда. Вы научитесь уверенно управлять байком под присмотром профи. До начальной точки маршрута участники добираются сами.

Заключительный перекус и возврат. Мы сделаем паузу на еду и отдых, подведем итоги заезда и вернемся в точку сбора.

program.en:
Day 1. Saigon - Long Hai Beach (140km)
Start the 7 day motorbike tour from Saigon at 8:30 Am. Hit the road straight to La Gi town, visit Minh Dam Army Base, Thuong Chieu Monastery pagoda, dip your body in the hot water springs, Binh Chau, open your mind to learn more about Buddhism when you go to visit Long Ban old pagoda and the historic vestige Dinh Mountain. Stay overnight in the hotel next to the beach of Long Hai.

Day 2. Long Hai - Mui Ne (130km)
It is a short ride today but it could be one of the best Vietnam motorcycle tours on coastlines. We can do some stops to visit the Champa’s villages and their temples to learn more about the Cham’s history and culture. Finish the short but enjoyable coastal road motorbike tour with a great swim at Mui Ne beach – one of the best beach in Vietnam.Stay in Hotel

Day 3. Mui Ne Motorbike Ride - Bao Loc (160km)
Leaving Mui Ne beach in the early morning with a short motorbike ride on the coastal road to some rustic fishing villages, have enjoyable time with fairy springs, red canyon and amazing white sand dunes, have talk with the local to know the daily life of farmers who plan the dragon fruits. And then Continue the 7 Day Southern Vietnam Motorbike Tour to the Central Highlands, we will stop in the K’ho ethnic minority village to learn more about their culture also the colorful hill tribe’s lives in Central Highlands. Arrive in Bao Loc after visiting Dambri waterfall – about 90 meters high. Over night in Bao Loc

Day 4. Bao Loc - Dak Mil (170km)
Keep motorcycle touring in Central Highlands Vietnam to Dak Mil, the motorbike ride in the highlands today offers great chances to visit the green tea farms, the colorful Di Linh Market with different cultures and customs of hill tribes, enjoy the hospitality of the E’de hill tribe by visiting their beautiful wooden long houses, We can have a short trek through the nice rainforest to see the beauty of the area. Arrive in Dak Mil around 5 pm. Stay in Hotel

Day 5. Dak Mil - Lak lake (165km)
Today is another enjoyable motorbike tour in Central Highlands Vietnam. We will ride through the Dray Sap and Dray Nu waterfalls (one of the most beautiful waterfalls of Vietnam) before have a great Ho Chi Minh trail motorcycle tour up to the north to the Lak lake. The Motorcycle ride on Ho Chi Minh trail offers plenty of historical sites and the breath-taking nature of the areas, we can have stops at some roadside villages to learn how the locals make rice papers, noodles, or trek to the top of elephant mountain to enjoy the panoramic views of the area, and then travel to Lak Lake before the sunset to have some great shots of M’nong Ethnic minority’s fishermen on the lake. Overnight in Lak lake. We can choose to do home-stay or stay in the guesthouse.

Day 6. Lak Lake - Nha Trang (195km)
You can ride elephant or have a boat ride to cross the Lake. After that we can have ashort walk to the village of the M’lieng and M’nong people to learn more about the culture of the hill tribes in Central Highlands Vietnam and see how the local make chopsticks, incenses. Then continue the Southern Vietnam Motorcycle Tour on stunning mountain roads of Phoenix Pass. We will then stop for a visit at the natural hot water springs to enjoy the nature and its beauty. Arrive in Nha Trang around 5 pm, check in the room and stay in Hotel.

Day 7. Nha Trang - Dalat (150km)
Start the last day of the Southern Vietnam motorcycle tour lately with a relaxing ride through peaceful countryside of the mountain area, explore the daily life and cultures of different ethnic minority groups. Learn about the farmers who cultivate goods on their lands such as flowers, coffee, tea, mushrooms… And then motorcycle up to Da Lat then arrive the town and end the great 7 Day Motorbike Tour on coastlines and Central Highlands Vietnam at around 4 PM. Check in the hotel of your choice and say good bye to the staff ofVietnam Motorbike Tour Expert.

program.en:
Day 1. Saigon - Cu Chi tunnels - Ben Tre (175km)
8:00 AM, Our tour guide and all bikes are ready at your hotel then we will start the tour after fitting the gears. It will take you around 1 hour to escape the busy city, and then we will spend a bout 1.5 hour to visit the historical Cu Chi tunnels to learn more about the Vietnam war. After that we mostly on a smooth paved road to get our of the city before enjoy riding on some scenic back roads through peaceful villages, huge farm of dragon fruit, larger green rice fields… also crossing a lot of ferries , narrow bridges… you will be in lovely place which called the kingdom of coconut in the south of Vietnam in late afternoon. You can stay at a basic standard hotel or home-stay.

Day 2. Ben Tre - Can Tho (150km)
Stand on your bikes after the breakfast, a lot of single tracks, bridges are waiting for you. Riding through many villages where you are welcomed by local people with big smiles. Arriving in Can Tho around 4:00 p.m, get a room in hotel and waiting for the floating market in the next morning. That’s a very special local market that they said “never been in the floating market, never been to Mekong Delta”(Hotel stay)

Day 3. Can Tho - Chau Doc (160km)
We call today is a day of bridges; you can’t remember how many bridges you pass through. A lot of beautiful canals follow you from the beginning until the end. The highlight for today is Tra Su cajuput forest, a must-see destination in all of Mekong Delta. It is also a mangrove forest, covers an area around 850 hectares with a lot of species: storks, snakes, turtles….. 1 hour on the boat trip to discover the beauty of the forest. After the forest, another short ride to the top of mountain where you can see the sunset and also the border between Vietnam and Cambodia. (Hotel stay)

Day 4. Chau Doc - Cai Be - Ben Tre (220km)
Another typical day of motorbike touring Mekong Delta with large and green rice fields, monkey bridges, ferries crosses….Today if the final day of the Mekong Delta part so enjoy every stop and take as many pictures as you can.

Day 5. Ben Tre - Vung Tau (170km)
The last rides in Mekong Delta in the morning before you are heading to the coast. if the weather is fine, so you can have a long boat trip to Vung Tau, a beautiful city with nice beaches. If the sea is rough or you don’t like to be on the boat, we can continue riding to. Check in the hotel then you have free time on the beach.

Day 6. Vung Tau - Mui Ne (200km)
Full day riding along the coast with a lot of beautiful beaches on the way, you can stop and go for quick swim if you want to. If you like water sports, you can do wind surfing, Jetsky…This must be one of the best day of this South Vietnam motorbike tour for the one who love and looking for a motorcycle tour along coastlines in Vietnam.

Day 7. Mui Ne - Da Lat (220km)
Say good bye to beaches, we’re heading to Da Lat up – a famous destination in the central highlands of Vietnam, where you can have four seasons in one day. Some back roads through pine forests look like you are riding in Europe and some off road through coffee plantations before you end up at the hotel. Night market after dinner is a good idea before goes to bed. (Hotel stay)

Day 8. Da Lat - Buon Ma Thuot (220km)
Buon Ma Thuot (BMT) is well-known as a capital of coffee in Vietnam. Riding motorbike through coffee plantations you will know how they grow and harvest, stop more on the way to try local coffee if you are interested. We do have elephants in Vietnam, and they mostly stay in this area. If the time permits, you can try elephant riding on the way to our hotel.

Day 9. Buon Me Thuot - Kon Tum (230km)
It’s another long day but it’s still very interesting ride. It will be most of the time riding on the historical Ho Chi Minh trails=, it is smooth and windy roads with spectacular scenery: waterfalls, swing bridges…1 hour to visit the ethnic museum in the city of Kon Tum to know more about cultures in the central highland before check in the hotel

Day 10. Kon Tum - Hoi An (300km)
The biggest day to end the great Saigon motorbike tour toMekong Deltaand Central Highlands Vietnam. The route is pretty easy and smooth on the Ho Chi Minh road. It takes about 7 hour riding through the coffee plantation, the view of nature and countryside on the roadside don’t make you boring but if you can start earlier the day, we can see more historical/cultural sites such as: My Son Holy land, same architectures as Angkor Temples in Cambodia. We will end the tour in late after noon in Hoi An. Say good bye to the team of Vietnam Motorbike Tour Expert and enjoy your time in Hoi An/Da NangMy Son Holy Land(The Angkor Wat of Vietnam) was the capital of Cham Pa Kingdom from the 4th to 5th centuries. Exemplifying the height of Cham architectural achievement, The My Son Sanctuary is a large complex of religious monuments originally consisting of more than 70 structures; the 25 vestiges of which remain today.The builders of My Son were the nobility of the Cham Pa Kingdom who derived their cultural and spiritual influences almost exclusively from India.Between the 4th to 13th centuries, there was a unique culture developed on the coast of contemporary Vietnam, owing its spiritual origins to the Indian Hinduism. This is demonstrated by the remains of a series of impressive tower-temples located in a dramatic site of My Son Holy Land, which was the religious and political capital of the Cham Pa Kingdom for most of its existence.Through stone stele and royal dynasties, My Son was proven to be the most important Holy Land of the Cham people during the mentioned centuries, reflecting their style and history. The Cham people belong to an ethnic group in Southeast Asia. They formed the core of the Muslim communities in both Cambodia and Vietnam. Cham is a remnant of the Cham Pa Kingdom (7th to 15th centuries), closely related to the Malay race.

program.en:
Day 1. Sai Gon - Cu Chi tunnels - Cai Be (180km)
Start the South Vietnam motorbike tour from Saigon city center at 8:00 AM, after getting out of the city we will motorcycle through the rustic but peaceful villages. The scene changes from bustling streets with buildings and noise to peaceful rice paddles with cottages and small houses on the way, like many other Mekong river Delta Vietnam Motorcycle Tours, The ride today let you inside into the heart of the sea of rice. After lunch, we will have enjoyable motorbike tour along the Tien River’s bank to feel and taste the real Vietnam beauty and culture with rice fields, orchards, water buffalos, ducks and cute kids along the way waving their hands and say ‘Hello” Arrive at Cai Be in the late afternoon and then take a boat trip with all the bikes to a peaceful village with hundred year old houses in which we will stay overnight in.Home stay in Cai Be.

Day 2. Cai Be - Vinh Long - Can Tho (90km)
Start the day with local coffee and traditional cake for break fast. Keep enjoin the Mekong delta motorbike tour through quiet villages of the local people living in between rice paddies, We will enjoy an easy offroad Vietnam motorbike tour and have short cruise on Tien River to visit the most unique floating market in South Vietnam. Disembark in Vinh Long where we have lunch, and keep heading to the south to Can Tho, It’s short motorbike ride in Mekong Delta region but impressive with daily life of the local and peaceful scenery.Overnight in Can Tho – Hotel stay

Day 3. Can Tho - Cai Rang floating Market – Sai Gon (180km)
It’s long but great motorcycle day tour in south Vietnam, after breakfast, motorcycle to Ninh Kieu Pier to take a boat trip to Cai Rang floating market, one of the busiest fruit market in Vietnam and even in Southeast Asia. We have a long distance cruise & walk on a quiet country road to take in the magnificent scenery and get close to the locals as they go about their daily routine, Then we will have short visit to Can Tho central market and Binh Thuy ancient house whose design is a combination of Vietnam and France with interesting involved stories but also a garden with various flowers and fruits, including a wide range of orchids and a record cactus. After lunch, enjoy a motorbike ride back to Sai Gon on the highway 1. Arrive the city in the late afternoon.Overnight in Sai Gon – hotel stay

Day 4. Sai Gon - Nam Cat Tien (170km)
This motorbike tour to Da Lat is a highlight of this South Vietnam motorbike tour, we will ride through the many tea and coffee plantations to the hill station of Da Lat – it’s known as the “City of Eternal Spring” orSapaof south Vietnam. The motorbike touring today is long but views are fantastic all along the way. Once arriving in Da Lat we can soak up the cool climate as much as we want by spending our time to wander around and catch our first glimpse of this town. The influence of the French is evident in local culture and architecture since Da Lat was founded as a hill retreat for the colonials to escape the oppressive heat in the coastal plains and the chaos of Saigon. This charming town is set around a lake and surrounded by forests, waterfalls and rolling countryside. Da Lat is also known as the ideal destination for honey moon!Overnight in Da Lat – hotel stay.

Day 5. Nam Cat Tien - Da Lat (190km)
Today we will have enjoyable Da Lat motorbike ride through the charming pine hill to the summer residence of Vietnam’s last Emperor Bao Dai. He was forced to abdicate in 1945, shortly after the end of the World War II. This mansion displays a lovely collection of Vietnam treasures. We follow it with a trip to the sacred Lam Ty Ni Pagoda and the Hang Nga Guesthouse. This construction is well known as the Crazy House because of its bizarre architecture. The lively central market and the old rail station are also visited and then we will ride through the undulating terrains to the picturesque coastal town of Mui Ne. This is a great motorbike tour on coastline in south Vietnam, get a lot of chance to see sandy beaches (Ca Na beach) and visit some friendly fishing, we will try to be in Mui Ne before sunset to get chance to picture some of wonderful photos.Overnight in Mui Ne – hotel stay.

Day 6. Da Lat - Phan Thiet (160km)
It’s relaxing today. Have a short motorbike tour to Phan Thiet and do a lot of visits to fishing villages learn more about the daily life of the local, learn how to make a fish net, how to earn a living with a fishing boat and a net, visit to Fairy stream or play and picture with the sand dunes. After checking in hotel, you can be free at the beach.Overnight in Phan Thiet – Hotel stay

Day 7. Phan Thiet - Sai Gon (180km)
Before having a long motorcycle tour back to Sai Gon, we will have short ride to visit to Duc Thanh School – the first school built in Central Vietnam where Ho Chi Minh used to be a teacher there. We will do some other stop to take some last pictures of the Mekong river delta motorcycle tour or visit some beautiful and special temples, pagodas to learn more about religion of the local. We will back to Saigon and end this enjoyableSouth Vietnam motorbike tourin the city at around 5 PM.

body: This enduro tour is your ticket to the breathtaking landscapes of Da Nang, where the mountains literally meet the sea. Forget the city traffic and head to the Son Tra Peninsula. You'll ride through dense tropical forests on red clay trails, tackle rocky climbs, and reach heights where the entire Danang Bay is visible. The route includes abandoned military roads and narrow paths used only by locals. You will experience the contrast between the salty sea breeze and the humid mountain air. This is a concentrated dose of adrenaline, technical riding, and stunning coastal scenery. Perfect for those who want to see the wild side of Da Nang in just a few hours!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.

program.en:
Day 1: Hanoi - Mai Chau Valley (170km) 
Depart from western edge of Hanoi at about 9:00, start motorbike riding to the Northwest of the Hanoi on the big free way. After one hour ride we’ll be in the countryside where the motorbike holiday is really enjoyable with riding on easy countryside back roads, seeing green nature and meeting smiling local people. The motorbike ride in the afternoon is surely the highlight of this North Vietnam motorbike tour with a lot of stop for beautiful pictures. We’ll be in Mai Chau valley at about 5:00 pm. Home stay in the villages of the Thai People.


Day 2: Mai Chau - Phu Yen (160km)
After breakfast and saying good bye to the Thai host, we keep motorbike touring up North Vietnam to Phu Yen. Today’s ride is short but offers some easy off-road challenge and many stops for picturing of landscapes and visiting the villages of local hill tribes. This ride also takes you to Moc Chau plateau in which you can see the large and green tea fields that become well-known to the Vietnamese people, in the afternoon, the motorcycle riding to Phu Yen offers amazing view along the beautiful Da river. Finish the enjoyable second day of the Motorbike tour in North Vietnam in a peaceful town Phu Yen at around 5:00 pm.

Check in the standard hotel in town.


Day 3: Phu Yen - Than Uyen (220km)
For many riders all over the world, Northern Vietnam includes some of the best routes for motorcycle touring and the route from Phu Yen to Than Uyen via Mu Cang Chai is one of them. The road today is all what you wish to have on a motorbike tour in Vietnam with beautiful rice terrace fields, colorful hill tribes along the road, quiet traffic and long mountain pass with imposing view. The ride offers many stops for picturing and visiting the local people. This promise to be one of the best Vietnam motorcycle tours. We’ll be in Than Uyen town and finish a great day riding at a hotel at around 5: 00 pm. Hotel stay.



Day 4: Than Uyen - Sapa (110km)
It’s another amazing day of motorbike touring in North Vietnam, this short motorbike tour to Sapa offers a great view of mountain with large green tea fields and imposing Fansipan peak, the ride will cross the O Qui Ho – one of the longest and most beautiful mountain passes in Northern Vietnam. You’ll have chance to take many pictures of breathtaking view of mountain at the level of around 2000 meters above sea level, riding a motorbike on this famous pass is surely a great experience, it’s surely one of the best part of this Vietnam motorcycle tours. We’ll finish riding in Sapa at noon then spend another half day to discover Sapa by foot of just take it easy to relax in town. Stay in hotel or home stay (optional)


Day 5: Sapa - Bac Ha (160km)
After breakfast in Sapa, we’ll hit the road all the way down from Sapa on another side of the Hoang Lien mountain range. It also offers a great view of nature with more terrace rice fields. The motorbike ride today is almost on the smooth roads along the Chinese border through some rustic villages and nice terrace fields. We’ll end the fifth day of Northern Vietnam motorbike tour in the little town of Bac Ha at around 4: 00 pm. Check in a standard hotel in town.

Day 6: Bac Ha - Ha Giang (190km)
This Vietnam motorcycle tour to Ha Giang today gives you a completely different taste of riding. It has more off-road motorbike riding options and also offers a different view of mountain from the ones you’ve seen before. In addition, the ride via Hoang Su Phi could give you one of the best view of rice terraces if you come at the right time, it will surely make you feel worthy to be here with the motorbikes. This could be the highlight of this 12 day motorbike tour in North Vietnam. We’ll arrive Ha Giang at around 5:00 pm. Hotel stay.


Day 7: Ha Giang - Dong Van - Meo Vac (170km)
Ha Giang – North Vietnam is always the best choice for any bikers who are looking for Vietnam motorcycle tours, being famous for the large and breathtaking plateau of rock with colorful and friendly people living around, Ha Giang and Dong Van Global Geo-park is always an attractive destination for motorcyclists whenever they come, you can see here the different beauties in different times and seasons. This Vietnam motorbike ride around Ha Giang should be the best part of this motorcycle tour in Vietnam. We’ll end the day in the middle of the rock plateau – little town of Meo Vac at around 5: 00 PM. Hotel stay.


Day 8: Meo Vac - Quang Uyen (200km)
Leaving the amazing rock plateau of Dong Van – Ha Giang for Quang Uyen – where you can experience another beauty of North Vietnam. The motorbike tour today offers quite different view of nature in another part of North Vietnam where the mountains are more green but lower with more villages and ethnic people. We’ll corss Cao Bang city to get to little town named Quang Uyen where we stay overnight at a homestay.

Meo Vac is one of the poorest and higheast district of Ha Giang province, Meo Vac is one of the important points in the development of tourism in Ha Giang in general in recent years. The main terrain of Meo Vac district is limestone mountains, with Nho Que river flowing through. Agricultural land occupies about 12,100 ha. Agricultural activities are the cultivation and exploitation of medicinal plants, fenugreek, pecans, etc., Beside there are some ethnic groups who are very friendly and has colorful traditional culture living in the peaceful villages on the mountains here making it become one of the hotest places for the fans of  motorcycle touring who are looking for fun and authentic Vietnam motorcycle tours.


Day 9: Quang Uyen - Ban Gioc waterfall - Cao Bang (180km)
The ride today is another highlight of this motorcyle tour North Vietnam. We’ll motorbike on almost quiet backroads through some peaceful villages with green peaceful view of nature. After having lunch nearby the Ban Gioc waterfalls, we’ll take some pictures of this largest waterfall in Vietnam before heading on another scenic road back to Cao Bang. Arrive at Cao Bang city at around 4:30. Check in the hotel then spend sometime to try some local beer in the city.

Day 10: Cao Bang - Ba Be lake (150km) 
– Ba Be lake, we’ll be there at lunch time then spend the afternoon with the team of Vietnam Motorbike Tour Expert to discover the lake by boat, swimming on the lake or having a short walk around the villages nearby the lake and the Ba Be National Park. We’ll stay with the Tay people at a nice house on stilts.

Ba Be Lake have a area of water surface around 500ha, with 8 km in length and 1 km in width it is known as the biggest natural lake in Vietnam, situated in Ba Be distric – around 250 km away from Hanoi .The Lake has very original and special features compared with other world-wide karster lakes: world karster lakes are spent or only with one-season water, while Ba Be Lake has its permanent full-water. There are 417 species of trees including 300 branches, 114 families. Also, you can see popularly hundreds of orchids and species of medicine-plants. The system of animals including; land, aquatic and flying animals covering 319 species of animals in 27 forms, 85 families in which 42 species recorded in Vietnam Red Book. In addition, the tracks around the Ba Be lake is so beautiful that make it an attractive destination that any Vietnam motorcycle tours must include.



Day 11: Ba Be lake - Thac Ba lake (170km)
The motorcycle ride today from Ba Be lake is almost on sealed back-roads with green view of nature and countryside, the ride is quite easy, it’s up and down on not so high mountains but offers many things to see and some interesting visits to rural villages of the hill tribes. We’ll arrive at a nice village of the Dzao people where we stay overnight at around 3:30 pm, leave the bikes at the homestay then spend the rest time of the day for the boat ride around the Thac Ba lake or easy walk around that peaceful village. Stay overnight in the stilt-house of the Dzao people’s village.


Day 12: Thac Ba lake - Hanoi (180km)
Saying goodbye to the family then start the ride at around 8:00 AM. We’ll take some easy off-road to get out of the villages then keep stay safe and relax on the dyke road along some little rivers to go down to Hanoi. Around last 15 km should be more difficult because we get closer to Hanoi city. We’ll end this great 12 day Vietnam motorcycle tours at around 4:30 PM at our bike shop in the western edge of the city. Leave the bikes at our shop then the Motorbike Tour Expert team will take you back to your hotel by car or taxi.

body:
This is one of our most spectacular Vietnam motorcycle adventures — a 12-day journey through the true highlights of Northern Vietnam. Riding across some of the most dramatic mountain passes in both the Northwest and Northeast regions from Hanoi, you’ll explore breathtaking terraced rice fields, the extraordinary Rock Plateau of Ha Giang – Dong Van, Vietnam’s largest waterfalls at Ban Gioc, and the country’s most picturesque natural lake, Ba Be Lake.

Blending scenic on-road stretches with exciting off-road sections, this immersive motorbike tour also offers meaningful encounters with local culture and daily life. While the weather in Northern Vietnam can be unpredictable, it consistently rewards riders with unforgettable landscapes and panoramic views. It’s no surprise that this itinerary remains one of the most popular options in our North Vietnam Motorbike Tours collection — a true once-in-a-lifetime experience. Let’s ride!

Вы можете путешествовать по всей территории Вьетнама! Хотя мы базируемся в Далате, наши байки готовы к дальним поездкам. Мы можем помочь вам проложить лучший маршрут по стране и предоставить поддержку через нашу сеть, если вы планируете межрегиональное путешествие.
Вы можете связаться с нами или посетить нас с 7:00 до 22:00 ежедневно. Мы всегда готовы помочь с арендой, забором или любыми вопросами, которые у вас могут возникнуть.
Могу ли я водить байк, не имея опыта вождения?

Конечно! Автоматические скутеры очень просты в обучении. Мы предоставляем бесплатное обучение для начинающих (обычно занимает около 15–30 минут). Мы научим вас механике и убедимся, что вы чувствуете себя уверенно перед выездом на дорогу. Гарантируем, что вы сможете ехать! ⚡
Стоимость аренды включает мотоцикл/скутер и защитный шлем. Для более длительных поездок мы также можем предоставить дождевые пончо и багажные ремни для закрепления вещей.
Для аренды байка вам необходимо оставить любой действующий документ удостоверяющий личность (удостоверение личности, водительские права или паспорт) и денежный депозит начиная от $200.
Кто платит за поломки или повреждения мотоцикла?
Всё, что произошло по вине клиента (падения, аварии или физические повреждения), оплачивается клиентом при ремонте. Нормальный износ или внутренние механические неисправности покрываются нами.
Можете ли вы дать советы, связанные с городом (помимо аренды)?
Конечно! Мы рады быть вашими местными гидами. Мы можем рассказать о лучших скрытых водопадах, самых вкусных местных заведениях, секретных барах и актуальных событиях в городе. 🍔🎪
Включает ли тур по Далату посещение водопадов?
Да! Вы легко можете добраться до водопадов Ба Хо или живописных перевалов в сторону Да Лат и Кам Рань.
Вы только сдаёте скутеры в аренду или есть другие приключения?

Мы — эксперты в приключениях! Помимо аренды скутеров, мы организуем профессиональные эндуро-туры по джунглям и горам. Если вы хотите чего-то особенного, например, Далатский каньонинг (спуск по водопаду), мы также можем связать вас с нашими самыми надёжными партнёрами. 🏔️🌲
Можно ли совместить поездку на байке с кофейным туром?

Это отличная идея! Вы можете прокатиться на арендованном байке по обширным кофейным плантациям Центрального нагорья, посмотреть как выращивают зёрна и попробовать настоящий вьетнамский кофе прямо у источника. ☕🌿
